description: Water Supply Catchments for Melbourne Water is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Layer containing water supply system catchment boundaries for water harvesting in the region of Melbourne. Includes catchment name, type, size of catchment and asset identifier. The type are defined by CATCHO (Open), CATCHC (Closed), and CATCH (Restricted). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Its tags are assets, catchment-boundaries, transfer-network, water-harvesting, water-supply. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
